notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Hello patch-notes-readers, and thanks for joining us on our first update since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536599641627558289] 1.0 Release![/url][/h3] The team here at Moonray Studios been keeping busy since we last spoke, with a major weapon rebalance, a few new features, and lots of bugfixes. Let's dive in!

[b]The biggest change you'll notice in 1.1 is the weapon rebalance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapons have been rescaled overall: Legendary weapons are mostly unchanged, but [b]Common weapons have been buffed significantly[/b], now performing at the level of the old rare weapons. Uncommon, Rare, and Epic weapons have been rescaled accordingly.
[*] You'll now only ever spawn with Common weapons (which are much better than they used to be).
[*] Weapons spawned around the world will always be Uncommon or better.
[*]  All weapons now come in every rarity. [expand type=details]In practice this means we have added 10 new weapons:
[list]
[*] Epic/Legendary Pistol
[*] Legendary Shotgun
[*] Common/Uncommon Sniper
[*] Common/Uncommon Thumper
[*] Common/Uncommon/Rare Carpet
[/list][/expand][*] Sniper damage has been rebalanced, and you can no longer one-shot enemies with no shield unless you get a headshot: 
[expand type=details][list]
[*] Previous: ~/~/100/115/130, with [b]2x headshot damage:[/b] ~/~/200/235/260
[*] New: 40/50/60/70/80, with [i][b]3x headshot damage:[/b][/i] 120/150/180/210/240
[/list][/expand][*] The Carpet, Thumper, and Torpedo now do bonus damage to blockers.
[/list]You might also notice a new [b]"Tournament Password"[/b] dropdown on the main menu, which you can use to set up larger private matches. By entering a password here, you'll only make matches with other lobbies using that password. For custom matches, each team should party up, and then when ready, you can enter a password to only matchmake with other teams using that password. This ensures your party won't be split up by the matchmaker.

[b]Some other changes in 1.1:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced total size on disk and further optimized RAM & VRAM usage.
[*] Added option in key bindings menu to reset to default bindings.
[*] Tweaked MMR values to make it a little more dynamic, i.e. each match should contribute more to your overall rating.
[/list][b]And as always, we took the time to squash some more bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that made the in-game menu sometimes inaccessible on controller.
[*] Fixed a longstanding visual bug when the other team quits a match, which would then show a "Round 2" or similar loading screen to remaining players during the post-game sequence.
[*] Fixed an issue where some text, including the tutorial, would not display when your system language is not set to English.
[*] Fixed a matchmaking bug that would sometimes cause a lobby merge failure.
[*] Removed bloom from the UI so it no longer feels like you're reading in a swimming pool.
[*] Fixed some UI Elements that were too blurry at lower quality settings.
[/list]Of course, the biggest problem we've been hearing from players is that they're having trouble finding a match. Unfortunately, that's one bug we're not currently able to fix via patch notes, but we do have a solution: Starting this weekend, we're introducing our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536600287259918649][b]Saturday Night Dives[/b][/url]: Every Saturday, we have [b]3 dedicated times[/b] for you to dive in and meet up with other players for a match. We've tried to spread them out to cover our fans in different time zones. 
Of course, you can enjoy Tidal Shock any day, any time if you bring a friend. (and why not? it's free after all!) Plus, you can always look for a game with the fine folks over on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCrVRDK][b]Discord Server[/b][/url].

That's all for now! Dive into the arena and check out the update for yourself!
🌊⚡

notes.title: Tidal Shock 1.0 Content Update
notes.content:
With the launch of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536599641627558289]Tidal Shock: Off the Hook 1.0[/url][/b], we’re not just bringing new modes, visuals, and chaos to the arena — We’re also bringing the fight to your hands. 
We have released our [b]Steam Deck–Ready native Linux build.[/b] It’s optimized, controller-tuned, and tested to run smooth — whether you’re docked, handheld, or somewhere in between.

We didn’t design for Deck on day one — but once we saw what this little machine could do, we knew we had to make a build for it.
✅ Native Linux version
✅ Full controller support
✅ Smooth performance and fast loads
✅ 360° underwater chaos that just feels right in your hands

If you’re a Steam Deck player, we built this for you. This isn’t just a game that runs — it [b]thrives[/b].
And we’re hoping your feedback helps push it toward full Verified status.

🎮 Practice in Solo Mode.
🛠️ Warm up in Private Matches.
💥 Ride torpedoes anywhere you want.
The ocean is open — and now it fits in your backpack.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3]🌊 The wait is over. 🌊[/h3]

After a long, scrappy ride through Early Access, we’re happy to announce that [b]Tidal Shock: Off the Hook 1.0 releases today[/b] — and we've got a whole host of changes for you, so let's dive right in!

A little over a month ago, we [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536595207289832525]started[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536595207289832527]quietly [/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/498315243308450894]making[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/498315243308450966]some[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/498315243308450968]big [/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/498315243308450970]updates[/url] while we prepared for our full release. In case you missed it, here's the gist:
[list]
[*] We took Tidal Shock off the hook - it's now [b]free to play![/b] (And never pay-to-win - the only things you can buy are cosmetics.)
[*] We added [b]all-new game modes: Depthmatch, Control, and Point-To-Point[/b] on top of our classic Reactor Rush mode, and each match is now a three-round burst of different modes across different parts of the Tidal Shock Arena!
[*] We expanded the map and now support matches of [b]up to 12 players[/b], plus team matches [i](we were sick of free-for-all too)[/i].
[*] We added [b]over 50 achievements![/b] [i](and there are even more today - see below!)[/i]
[*] We added [b]Rankings, XP & Awards[/b] for unlocking prestige skins, and an [b]MMR system[/b] to find other players at your skill level.
[*] We gave the whole game a makeover, from the map to the characters to the HUD.
[*] We added new skins to unlock, and premium skins to buy, including the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358730?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=release&utm_content=gear-pack]Gear Pack[/url][/b], finally letting you ride in style. 
[*] We made tons of rebalances, performance improvements, and bugfixes.
[*] Plus, every week we hosted [b]events and DLC giveaways![/b]
[/list]But that's not what this announcement is about - today we're releasing [b]Tidal Shock 1.0[/b], our full release out of early access, including a ton of new content:
[list]
[*] The long-requested and long-awaited [b]tutorial [/b]is finally here (optional of course). No more dropping into your first match with a pro while you're still learning how to use the torpedo. Because also releasing today are...
[*] [b]Private matches[/b]! You won't earn XP or achievements, but now you can dive in with friends for a grudge match or to learn the ropes with a buddy. You can also hop in solo get a feel for the arena at your own pace.
[*] If in-game tutorials aren't your style, we also have a short [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MWM8Fq9W30k]Player's Guide Video[/url][/b] to get you up to speed.
[*] [b]The map has expanded once more[/b] - There's a whole new area to explore (the minefield), plus some major changes inside the existing map that we hope will shake things up for those who have it memorized.
[*] We're also launching our [b]native linux build[/b] today! Steam deck users in particular should notice a significant performance increase. [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536599641627558293]Check it out![/url][/b]
[*] And finally, we're releasing [b]7 new achievements[/b] today, each focused on mastering every weapon in the game:
[list]
🛡️ Not So Fast
🛡️ Hail Mary
🛡️ Sharpshooter
🛡️ Splash Damage
🛡️ Nowhere To Hide
🛡️ Spray and Pray
🛡️ Fish In a Barrel
[/list][/list]In celebration of our release, we're also running a launch week sale: [b]All Character Packs are 15% off![/b] On top of that we're releasing two new bundles for those who want to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52898/Dip_Your_Toes/]Dip Their Toes[/url][/b], or even take a [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52899/Deep_Dive/]Deep Dive[/url][/b] into Moonray Studios' back-catalog, pairing some sweet Tidal Shock Character Packs with our last game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/669660/Debris/]Debris [/url][/b]- Tidal Shock's narrative-driven older sibling, for a fraction of the price! [b]Check them out now![/b]

[h3]❤️ From Us to You[/h3]
We’re a tiny indie team. We built this on guts, glowsticks, and way too much caffeine.
We couldn’t have done it without your feedback, chaos, and love.
[b]If you’re enjoying the ride, leave a review, and tell your friends![/b] Tidal Shock has been a labor of love, and more than anything we would love to keep improving and updating Tidal Shock for you guys.

Thank you for the support. We hope you enjoy playing the game as much as we've loved making it.

🌊[b]See you in the arena![/b]
[b][[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1262890?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=release&utm_content=play-now]Play Now[/url]] | [[url=https://discord.gg/SCrVRDK]Join the Discord[/url]][/b]

notes.title: Full Throttle Event (March 31-April 17)
notes.content:
[h3]🏁 We're on the home stretch now 🏁[/h3]

It's time for our final event before the 1.0 Release - It's the [b]Full Throttle Event![/b] No more forced game modes - from today until launch, we'll be continually updating and improving every part of Tidal Shock based on your feedback. Speaking of updates, we have quite a few pieces of news to share - let's dive into it:

[list]
[*]First off, we've pushed our release date a little further to give us time to make some of the changes we'd like included in version 1.0: We're now planning to [b]launch out of Early Access on Friday, April 18![/b]
[*] Of course, the DLC giveaways are still running, and will be all the way until launch! You can enter to win on [url=https://discord.gg/a4jFs3QBNN]Discord[/url] - this time we're giving away [b]FREE [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358720?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=f2p-week-5&utm_content=puffs-character-packs]Puffs Character Packs[/url]![/b]
[*] There are also a few more [b]achievements[/b] coming out today:
[list]
🛡️ Depth Charge
🛡️ Triple Crown
🛡️ Perfect Score
[/list](We also have 7 new achievements dropping on launch day - but we're keeping tight-lipped about those for now.)
[*] And as always, we're working hard in the background to keep the [b]updates[/b] rolling. Here's a taste of the changes you'll see in the latest version of Tidal Shock:
[list]
[*]Control has been simplified - instead of multiple sub-rounds, the control point will move around the map whenever a single team manages to score 50 point at that location. First to 100 points wins!
[*]You now get a kill if a player suicides within 5 seconds of you damaging them. With this change in mind, we've also removed the -1 point penalty for suicide in Depthmatch.
[*]And more! Check out the full patch notes [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536597739399546475]here[/url][/b]!
[/list][*] Finally, we've been working on [b]Steam Deck compatibility[/b] in preparation for 1.0, and we think we're nearly there! If you'd like to try out our latest steam deck build and give us your feedback, reach out to us on [b][url=https://discord.gg/SCrVRDK]Discord[/url][/b] and we'll hook you up with the beta! Our Discord server is also the best place to get in touch with feedback, suggestions, or just to connect with the community and find a match!
[/list]
[b]🌊 It's all happening right now - dive in to check it out. We can't wait to see you on launch day![/b]

notes.title: Power Play Event (March 24-30)
notes.content:
[h3]⚡ A Shocking Twist on a Classic ⚡[/h3]

We're back at it again with a brand-new event this week - it's a power play! This week, we're featuring the last of our four game modes, [b]Point-To-Point[/b] as the first round of every match. The gist is this: get energy, and charge the reactor. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536595207289832527]Sound familiar?[/url] The catch is that in Point-To-Point, there's only ever [b]one[/b] place on the map to generate that energy, and it's bound to be teeming with foes. You'll need strategy, patience, and perfect timing to get out without alerting your enemies, and to sneak it to the reactor to claim victory!

🎁 As for the gifts that keep on giving, this week also kicks off new DLC giveaways - enter on the [url=https://discord.gg/a4jFs3QBNN]Tidal Shock Discord Server[/url] for your chance to win a [b]FREE [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276780?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=f2p-week-4&utm_content=shallows-character-pack]Shallows Character Pack[/url]![/b]

We're rolling out some new [b]achievements[/b] out this week too, to unlock on your quest from point-to-point:
[list]
🛡️ Reactor Raider
🛡️ Tidal Terror
🛡️ +1 Hidden Achievement (SPOILER: [spoiler]Unlucky Ducky[/spoiler])
[/list]
Last week we also addressed a few major bugs, and seriously improved the Tidal Shock experience on controller. There's never been a better time to dive into the arena! But if you're looking for the [i]perfect[/i] time, we suggest signing up for our [b][url=https://discord.gg/Qwf4TS6VuY?event=1351964339325894807]Dip Your Toes[/url][/b] event, happening over on our Discord server. It'll give you a chance to get into some big matches with other Tidal Shock fans!

🌊 See you in the arena!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.16b
notes.content:
A bit of a mish-mash of bug fixes, cleanup and gameplay tweaks this time:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue when other players quit the match while you were still loading in, that manifested in a few ways:
[list]
[*] Sometimes you'd get stuck on the loading screen
[*] Sometimes you'd get into the match alone without disconnecting automatically
[*] Sometimes you'd be pushed back to the main menu, but with weird lighting and have trouble rejoining the queue
[*] Sometimes you'd make it back to the menu, but then when you tried to play again you'd be kicked out of the match, with in-game HUD and lots of other visual craziness
[/list] [*] Fixed the matchmaker sometimes mixing up which players should go on which team, in particular brand new players getting paired up against players who had played a lot, but had lost a few games recently.
[*] Increased torpedo damage from 80 to 125 - it should have no trouble plowing through enemy blockers now!
[list]
[*] Self-damage also slightly increased from 20 to 25
[/list] [*] Removed a bunch of old content that's no longer in use, shrinking the install size a bit and hopefully also improving performance a little.
[/list]
🌊Hop in and check it out!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.14f
notes.content:
This patch makes significant improvements to our controller support, which has had some nasty bugs since our free-to-play transition.

The following fixes are included:
[list]
[*] All menus are now navigable entirely with the controller.
[*] Settings menu has a new layout that is much more controller-friendly.
[*] You'll no longer be navigating the in-game menu in the background while playing - an issue that sometimes caused you to open settings pages or even quit the game accidentally!
[*] Torpedo is now useable on controller no matter what your base sensitivity is.
[*] You'll no longer drop a blocker when resuming on controller in the in-game menu.
[*] Improved UI navigation speed on controller.
[/list]
Other Misc. Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes the game would crash as you were trying to quit.
[*] (Hopefully!) Fixed an issue where temp graphics would sometimes show up when loading into a match.
[/list]

notes.title: Under Control Event (March 17-23)
notes.content:
[h3]🔒 Hold the Line. Lock Down the Depths 🔒[/h3]
This week's feature mode is all about teamwork, positioning, and tactics. In [b]Control[/b], you'll need to hold critical zones, lock down objectives with shields, and stop enemies from taking over your territory. With a guaranteed first round of Control each match, the master tacticians will rise to the top this week.

🎁 The giveaways are still going strong on [b][url=https://discord.gg/a4jFs3QBNN]Discord[/url][/b]! This week, we're giving away [b]FREE [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358710?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=f2p-week-3&utm_content=slicks-character-packs]Slicks Character Packs[/url]![/b] Join the community and zip through the seas in style 😎

In the spirit of our featured mode, we also have some new Control-centric [b]achievements[/b] debuting this week:
[list]
🛡️ Control Conqueror
🛡️ The Best Defense... 
🛡️ +1 Hidden Achievement (SPOILER: [spoiler]Eleventh Hour[/spoiler])
[/list]
You might have also noticed an [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/537722458840498931]update[/url] on Friday, which contained some [b]major performance improvements[/b] across the board. If you were having trouble loading the game on a previous version, try giving it a spin now - there's room in the arena for everyone!

Some more exciting news: We've teamed up with [b]Alienware Arena[/b], who have set up a quest to earn ARP by playing Tidal Shock for at least 1 hour this week. Check it out [url=https://www.alienwarearena.com/steam/quests/tidal-shock]here[/url], and stay tuned later this week as we roll out more new content with our friends at Alienware.

Meanwhile, on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCrVRDK]Discord Server[/url], the people have spoken: [i]Deathmatch O2 is out, and [b]Depthmatch is in![/b][/i] We'll be updating everything and pushing out the updated content later this week.
We also kicked off our first [b]Saturday Night Dive[/b] event over the weekend, with our developers duking it out with the community for and awesome night of games. We'll be doing this every weekend, so don't forget to check it out and dive in this coming Saturday! You can sign up on [url=https://discord.gg/SCrVRDK]Discord[/url].

🌊 Stay cool, and stay in control. See you in the arena!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.13e
notes.content:
[h3]You may have noticed Tidal Shock was running a little slow...[/h3]

In our excitement to deliver so much new content with our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1262890/view/536595207289832525?l=english]Off The Hook Update[/url][/b], we [i]may have[/i] neglected some performance considerations. This update addresses them in a few ways:
[list]
[*] We've added a quality dropdown to the settings menu with 7 presets ranging from Minimum to Ultra, to handle machines of all shapes and sizes [i](but we're begging you not to use minimum quality... it makes the artists cry)[/i]. 
[*] Across all quality settings, you should see a small performance boost from some overall cleanup we've done. Most noticeably, it shouldn't be hoarding RAM (sometimes up to 14GB) and VRAM (sometimes up to 7GB!) like it used to. 
[/list]
Our lead dev [i]claims[/i] that you could play the game with under 4GB RAM and 1GB VRAM now, but we don't have a machine like that to test on, so decide for yourself if you want to believe him. If he's wrong, feel free to give him hell on the [b][url=https://discord.gg/Z8zt6hBTJs]#tidalshock-bugs[/url][/b] channel on Discord.

[b]One more thing! [/b]The first time you launch after this update, a quality setting will be picked automatically for you, but that's just a guess at which setting will run well on your machine - hop in a match and switch settings on the fly to see what works best for you!

🌊 [b]See you in the arena![/b]

notes.title: Tidal Shock is Going Off The Hook!
notes.content:
[h2]🚨 Tidal Shock is BACK – and Bigger Than Ever! 🚨[/h2]

[h3]Hey Divers! 🌊[/h3]
It’s been a long time… but we’re finally back. And we didn’t just dust off Tidal Shock—we rebuilt it from the ground up.

[h3]Introducing Tidal Shock: Off the Hook![/h3]
As of today, Tidal Shock is officially [b]Free To Play[/b], and preparing for our 1.0 Release out of Early Access on April 10th! It's never been easier to grab a friend and dive back into the Tidal Shock arena!

But going free-to-play might be the smallest change we've made... We've been working hard to deliver a deluge of new content to sink your teeth into, like:
[list]
[*] [b]A Complete Visual Overhaul[/b] – It’s faster, sleeker, and better than ever.
[*] [b]Three-Round Matches[/b] – More strategy, more action, more fun, and more chances to get back at your rivals, featuring...
[*] [b]Three New Game Modes[/b] – For a total of four. Control, Point-To-Point, and Deathmatch O₂ are now available alongside the classic Tidal Shock game mode, Reactor Rush.
[*] [b]A Matchmaking Rating System[/b] – Build your rating and prove you're the king of the ocean. 
[*] [b]Tons of New Achievements[/b] –  We've added more than 20 achievements to the game, with new ones added every week leading up to our 1.0 Release.
[*] [b]Team Play[/b] – Squad up and work together to outwit your opponents, now in matches of up to 12 players!
[*] [b]Post-Game Awards[/b] – Flex on the competition.
[*] [b]New Progression & Customization[/b] – Earn XP and climb the food chain from Guppy to Orca, unlocking skins along the way.
[*] [b]Speaking of Skins[/b] – we're releasing 4 new skin packs this week, including the Gear Pack, which lets you ([i]finally![/i]) customize your torpedo and blocker.
[/list]
Thank you so much to the fans who have been there since the beginning. If you owned Tidal Shock before our switch to Free To Play, you should find you've been given some of our new skins as a token of our appreciation.

[h3]🌊[b]Dive In Now[/b] and see everything Tidal Shock: Off The Hook has to offer![/h3]
[previewyoutube=MIqGzU9ZJNs;full] [/previewyoutube]

[h3]But That's Not All![/h3]
We've got our eyes on the future, and our [b]1.0 release[/b] is coming very soon! We'll be running new events every week until then, featuring game modes and [b]adding new achievements[/b], [b]giving away Skin Packs everyday[/b] on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCrVRDK]Discord server[/url], fixing bugs, and looking for [b]your feedback[/b] on the direction to take Tidal Shock as we grow!

[b]Excited? So Are We.[/b]
Check out our Off The Hook [url=https://tidalshock.com/]website[/url] for all the details, including our [url=https://tidalshock.com/ROAD_2_RELEASE.html]Roadmap To Release[/url] for a sneak peek of what's coming! 
💬 [b]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/SCrVRDK]Discord community[/url][/b] to enter giveaways, get in touch, and keep up with the latest events!
🏊‍♀️🏊‍♂️ Don't forget to [b]invite your friends[/b]! It's dangerous to go alone.
See you in the arena! 💙🐠
